originals.ko: 이 일은 오늘 더 오래 걸리고 있어

originals.why: Natural North Welsh: 'ychydig bach yn hirach' is idiomatic. 'hirach' means longer in time, which is the sense taught here.

originals.ko: 우리와 조금 더 오래 느긋하게 쉬다
originals.why: Natural and grammatical. 'hirach' is used for duration, the same sense taught here.

originals.ko: 나는 더 오래 기다리고 싶지 않아
너 조금 더 오래 기다려야 해?
originals.why: Natural and idiomatic. 'aros am ychydig bach hirach' is a common North Welsh phrasing, and 'hirach' is used for duration.

originals.ko: 응, 나는 조금 더 오래 느긋하게 쉬고 싶어
originals.why: Natural North Welsh. 'hirach' is used for duration, the same sense taught here.

originals.ko: 나는 오늘 저녁에 조금 더 오래 느긋하게 쉬면 좋겠어
originals.why: Natural. 'liciwn i' plus a verbnoun plus 'ychydig bach hirach heno' is idiomatic, and 'hirach' is used for duration.
